violation_type.title: Safety - Sliding Door Glass Marked (26 TAC §744.2601(4))
violation_type.typical_finding: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation and found to be deficient after a child was injured after running into an unmarked glass door. This was addressed during the initiation. Due to daycare being closed, I recommended they have a plan to get decals on the doors before children are in care. Photos to be sent once it has been completed.
